typography.note: Lockup SVGs use text elements; convert to paths in the assets repo if needed.

icon.icon-dark.svg: Full icon for dark backgrounds (transparent). Design doc 3a.
icon.icon-light.svg: Full icon for light backgrounds (transparent). Accent #C89200.
icon.icon-mono.svg: Monochrome for e-paper / single-ink devices. Design doc 3e.
icon.icon-favicon.svg: Simplified bar-only mark for 16px. Design doc 3f.

lockup-horizontal.lockup-horizontal-dark.svg: Primary nav/header lockup on dark. Design doc 3b.

wordmark.wordmark-dark.svg: Text + refresh lines only. Design doc 3d.

png.icon/dark|light|mono: Square transparent PNGs at 16-1024px (full icon geometry)
png.app-icon/on-black|on-white: Icon centred on solid square with padding (app store style)
png.web: Ready-to-drop web bundle: favicon.ico, favicon-16/32, apple-touch-icon, icon-192, icon-512

usageRules: Use horizontal lockup (3b) in headers and wide UI.
Use icon only from 24px+; drop second text line below ~24px.
Use icon-favicon / 16px PNG for browser favicons.
Use mono variants only on e-paper or single-ink hardware.
Yellow-dark (#FFB300) on black; yellow-light (#C89200) on white.
generatePng: cd brand-export && npm install && npm run generate
